name: Cursor click
summary: Classic arrow cursor glides from a start point to a target, then clicks with a ripple ring.

params.name: x
params.note: target: the cursor tip ends here

params.name: y
params.note: target: the cursor tip ends here

params.name: ax
params.note: start x of the cursor tip

params.name: ay
params.note: start y of the cursor tip

params.name: color
params.note: ripple colour; default the style's accent

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

author: krakujs
